## Project Proposal

**Project title:** Exploring Marketing Performance Through R Visualization

**Data and source:** A documented course or approved marketing dataset; the chart below uses the explicitly synthetic CSV bundled with this portfolio.

**Managerial problem:** Raw performance tables are difficult for decision-makers to interpret quickly.

**Target audience:** Marketing analysts and marketing managers.

**Research questions:** How do metrics vary across acquisition channels? Which patterns deserve further investigation?

**Expected business impact:** Make performance differences easier to communicate and help prioritize follow-up analysis.

**Quantitative methods:** Grouped descriptive statistics, proportions, comparisons, and bar charts using R and ggplot2.

## R Example

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
d <- read.csv("data/ga4_sample.csv")
s <- aggregate(sessions ~ channel, data=d, FUN=sum)
ggplot(s, aes(x=channel, y=sessions)) + geom_col(fill="#806a83") +
  labs(title="Example sessions by channel (synthetic data)", x="Channel", y="Sessions") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12)
```

**Status:** Demonstration of analytical methods; real data and results will be added when available.
